skill_name: Write a summary of the novel "1984" by George Orwell.
workflow: 1984 by George Orwell is a dystopian novel set in a totalitarian society ruled by a powerful and mysterious figure known as Big Brother. The novel follows protagonist Winston Smith, who works for the Ministry of Truth, as he struggles against the oppressive government and grappling with his own personal beliefs and loyalties to Big Brother.
